basic_info.description: Situated on the top floor of an iconic Victorian building, this sweet and bright one-bedroom condo exudes charm and practicality. A south-facing living room is flooded with natural light, and features a walkout deck with green outlooks through sliding glass doors. Adjacent is an updated kitchen with an eat-in peninsula, a large skylight, and great cabinet space. Down the hall, an oversized bedroom is equipped with a walk-in closet and separate desk/seating area nestled in the corner turret, and a full bath with in-unit laundry. Additionally, this unit has considerable closet/storage space and includes a one-car deeded garage. Ideally located between Buena Vista and Golden Gate Park, steps to Cole Valley and the center of Haight Ashbury, this location has it all.
